message: This pull request changes a part of your product description under `docs/spec/` that you had settled — the ground the build works from. A settled description shouldn't change quietly. If you mean to make the change, confirm it by applying the `guardrail-ack` label to this pull request — one deliberate action, distinct from clicking merge. That clears this check on its own, with no new commit needed; the finding names each settled document that changed (reopening one counts as a change too). The blocking check is `engine-ci`; the `engine-guard` check stays green because it only flags changes that weaken the engine's guardrails, and editing a settled description isn't one of those — so a green `engine-guard` doesn't mean you're done here. Your confirmation is bound to the exact version you settle from, so if you push a further change after applying the label, apply it again for the new version. It reads which documents were settled from the pull request's starting point, so that record can't be edited away in the same change. This check judges only that a settled description doesn't change without your say-so — never whether the change is a good one; that stays your call. It reads your files and never changes them.
